title: Kent Selin sees flux liner over Edwards

tellings.quote: He talked to an individual named Kent Selin who said he saw this over Edwards Air Force Base in the 70s.

plain: A man named Kent Selin says he saw a craft called the flux liner flying over Edwards Air Force Base in California in the 1970s. The story reaches Michels at a remove: a man who goes by UAPGerb says that a man named Mark McCandlish talked to Selin, who told him what he saw. If true, it would mean such a craft was flying over a known military test base decades ago.
